- '3.11'

about.description:

modelling package foxes. It is based on the optimization interface package
iwopy, and enables the user to run fast vectorized and flexible optimizations
of wind farm layouts, wind farm control parameters, or any other set of
related model parameters.

name: foxes-opt
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "foxes-opt" %}
{% set version = "0.8.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3dceeb31a48055a7612ab3dbd8ead18cd06ec01618d2b5a990afbd088f1d0ad4

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0
  entry_points:
    - foxes_opt_yaml = foxes_opt.input.yaml.yaml:foxes_opt_yaml

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=84.0.0
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - foxes >=1.9.2
    - iwopy >=0.3.1
    - pymoo >=0.6
    - xarray >=2023.9
    - netcdf4 >=1.7

test:
  imports:
    - foxes_opt
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - pytest >=7.0
  source_files:
    - tests
  commands:
    - pip check
    - pytest tests
    - foxes_opt_yaml --help

about:
  home: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt
  summary: Wind farm optimization functionality for foxes
  description: |
    This package provides optimization functionality for the wind farm and wake
    modelling package foxes. It is based on the optimization interface package
    iwopy, and enables the user to run fast vectorized and flexible optimizations
    of wind farm layouts, wind farm control parameters, or any other set of
    related model parameters.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://fraunhoferiwes.github.io/foxes-opt/index.html
  dev_url: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - SchmJo
